items.source_title: sqlite-utils 4.0rc2, mostly written by Claude Fable
items.headline: ai review caught a real data-loss bug
items.body: claude fable's review of sqlite-utils 4.0rc2 caught a real bug: delete_where() never committed and quietly poisoned the connection. that's exactly the class of failure dota-deals is built to survive — its retry and structured-logging layer exists because steam market ingestion has to tolerate partial failures. worth running the same kind of review pass over dota-deals' data layer; transaction bugs like this hide well in code that looks finished.
